groups.name: Ledger filter optimization
groups.rationale: Adds query filters to the ledger store so that reading a session's annotations scans only relevant month files and lines instead of parsing the entire ledger.
groups.watch: The substring gate lineMayMatch uses JSON.stringify checks that could have false positives; recordMatches must correctly distinguish records even when the gate admits them. The monthInRange function compares only YYYY-MM prefixes, which works for ISO timestamps but would break if the format changes.

groups.name: Session annotations lookup
groups.rationale: Changes sessionAnnotations to use the new store-level filters instead of fetching all records and filtering in memory, reducing cost from every line in the ledger to only the session's rounds.
groups.watch: The function now filters by kind, repo, and rounds; it must correctly extract round ids from the session and handle the case where a session has no rounds (returns empty array rather than querying).

groups.name: Documentation and changelog
groups.rationale: Updates the backlog to mark the ledger-scanning problem as solved and documents the performance improvement measured on a real ledger.
groups.watch: The claim that corrupt count now reflects only filtered lines while stats() reflects the full count must remain true; a future caller must not confuse which metric they are reading.

groups.name: Explanatory artifacts
groups.rationale: Adds design documents and reference implementations for related work on file focus states, approval carry-forward, and draft preservation—context for understanding the scope of the ledger optimization.
groups.watch: These are planning and reference documents with no runtime effect; they document decisions made elsewhere. Verify they do not contradict the actual code changes if any reader references them later.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
